title: Kubernetes Cluster Ingress & Service Mesh Topology
description: Visualizes end-to-end traffic flow from external clients through Ingress, ClusterIP service abstraction, and target Pod replicas.
mermaid_definition:
graph TD
    Client([External Client]) --> Ingress[NGINX / ALB Ingress Controller]
    Ingress --> Service[ClusterIP Service: api-svc]
    Service --> Pod1[Pod Replica 1: FastAPI App]
    Service --> Pod2[Pod Replica 2: FastAPI App]
    Service --> Pod3[Pod Replica 3: FastAPI App]
    Pod1 --> DB[(PostgreSQL Database Cluster)]
    Pod2 --> DB
    Pod3 --> DB

description: Decoupled distributed services communicating via Kafka / RabbitMQ message brokers with independent databases.

flowchart LR

    Gateway --> UserSvc[User Microservice]
    OrderSvc --> Broker{{Kafka Message Broker}}
    Broker --> PaymentSvc[Payment Worker Service]
    Broker --> NotifySvc[Notification Service]
    OrderSvc --> OrderDB[(Order Store)]

title: Production MLOps Training & Serving Architecture
description: Continuous training loop from feature store through model registry to real-time inference endpoints.
mermaid_definition:
flowchart TD
    Data[(Raw Lake / Feature Store)] --> Preprocess[Feature Engineering & Validation]
    Preprocess --> Train[Distributed PyTorch Training on GPU]
    Train --> Eval[Model Evaluation & Threshold Verification]
    Eval --> Registry[MLflow Model Registry (Production Staging)]
    Registry --> Deploy[Triton / FastAPI Serving Cluster]
    Deploy --> Monitor[Drift & Latency Telemetry Monitor]
    Monitor -->|Trigger Retrain| Preprocess

title: Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) 3-Statement Modeling Flow
description: Demonstrates the step-by-step calculation from revenue forecasting to Enterprise Value and equity share price.
mermaid_definition:
graph TD
    IS[Income Statement Revenue & EBITDA] --> EBIT[Operating Profit: EBIT]
    EBIT --> NOPAT[Net Operating Profit After Tax: NOPAT]
    NOPAT --> UFCF[Unlevered Free Cash Flow: UFCF = NOPAT + D&A - CapEx - Change in NWC]
    WACC[Calculate Weighted Average Cost of Capital: WACC] --> PV[Discount Cash Flows to Present Value]
    UFCF --> PV
    PV --> EV[Enterprise Value = Sum of PV + Terminal Value]
    EV --> EqVal[Equity Value = EV - Net Debt]
    EqVal --> TargetPrice[Implied Share Price = Equity Value / Shares Outstanding]

title: Clinical Patient Triage & EHR Order Lifecycle
description: Emergency department patient admission, Acuity triage grading (ESI 1-5), and EHR charting workflow.
mermaid_definition:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> IntakeTriage: Patient Presentation
    IntakeTriage --> AcuityRating: Emergency Severity Index (ESI 1-5)
    AcuityRating --> Resuscitation: ESI Level 1 (Immediate Bedside)
    AcuityRating --> EmergentCare: ESI Level 2
    AcuityRating --> UrgentCare: ESI Level 3-5
    EmergentCare --> EHRCharting: Vital Signs & Physician Orders Entered
    UrgentCare --> EHRCharting
    EHRCharting --> MedicationAdmin: eMAR Barcode Verification
    MedicationAdmin --> Disposition: Discharge or Inpatient Admission
    Disposition --> [*]

title: HL7 v2 to FHIR Clinical Interoperability Bridge
description: Transforming legacy hospital HL7 v2 messages (ADT/ORM) into RESTful SMART-on-FHIR JSON resources.
mermaid_definition:
sequenceDiagram
    participant EHR as Hospital EHR (Epic/Cerner)
    participant Engine as Interface Engine (Mirth/Rhapsody)
    participant FHIR as HAPI FHIR Server
    participant App as HealthTech Analytics App
    EHR->>Engine: HL7 v2.5.1 ADT^A01 (Inpatient Admission Message)
    Engine->>Engine: Parse MSH, PID, PV1 segments
    Engine->>FHIR: POST /Patient & POST /Encounter (FHIR JSON)
    FHIR-->>Engine: 201 Created (UUID Resource)
    App->>FHIR: GET /Patient?birthdate=gt1980 (SMART on FHIR)
    FHIR-->>App: Bundle of Verified Patient Resources

title: Commercial Enterprise Contract Negotiation & Due Diligence
description: Standard review gates from initial NDA execution through redlining risk covenants to final signature.
mermaid_definition:
flowchart TD
    Start([Proposed Agreement Received]) --> NDA[Mutual NDA Verification]
    NDA --> RiskReview[Risk Assessment: Indemnity, Liability Cap, IP Rights]
    RiskReview --> Redline[First-Pass Redline Draft Generated]
    Redline --> InternalReview{General Counsel & Executive Approval}
    InternalReview -->|Disputed Terms| CounterNegotiate[Counter-Party Redline Negotiations]
    CounterNegotiate --> RiskReview
    InternalReview -->|Approved| Execution[DocuSign Signature & Certificate]
    Execution --> ComplianceArchive[(Compliance Contract Repository & Audit Trail)]

title: Industrial PLC Control & SCADA Telemetry Loop
description: Closed-loop feedback from physical field sensors through PLC ladder logic to supervisory SCADA HMI consoles.
mermaid_definition:
graph LR
    Sensors[Field Sensors: 4-20mA Temp/Pressure Transducers] --> IOMeta[PLC Input Card: 24VDC Analog Module]
    IOMeta --> CPU[PLC CPU: Ladder Logic Scan Cycle]
    CPU --> OutputCard[PLC Output Relay Module]
    OutputCard --> Actuator[VFD Motor Controller / Pneumatic Valve]
    CPU --> Modbus[Modbus TCP / BACnet Gateway]
    Modbus --> SCADA[SCADA / HMI Operator Workstation Console]
